papers.title: Marine Biomaterial-Based Bioinks for Generating 3D Printed Tissue Constructs.
papers.abstract: Biologically active materials from marine sources have been receiving increasing attention as they are free from the transmissible diseases and religious restrictions associated with the use of mammalian resources. Among various other biomaterials from marine sources, alginate and fish gelatin (f-gelatin), with their inherent bioactivity and physicochemical tunability, have been studied extensively and applied in various biomedical fields such as regenerative medicine, tissue engineering, and pharmaceutical products. In this study, by using alginate and f-gelatin's chemical derivatives, we developed a marine-based interpenetrating polymer network (IPN) hydrogel consisting of alginate and f-gelatin methacryloyl (f-GelMA) networks via physical and chemical crosslinking methods, respectively. We then evaluated their physical properties (mechanical strength, swelling degree, and degradation rate) and cell behavior in hydrogels. Our results showed that the alginate/f-GelMA hydrogel displayed unique physical properties compared to when alginate and f-GelMA were used separately. These properties included high mechanical strength, low swelling and degradation rate, and an increase in cell adhesive ability. Moreover, for the first time, we introduced and optimized the application of alginate/f-GelMA hydrogel in a three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting system with high cell viability, which breaks the restriction of their utilization in tissue engineering applications and suggests that alginate/f-GelMA can be utilized as a novel bioink to broaden the uses of marine products in biomedical fields.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何人工智能或机器学习技术在生物打印中的应用，仅关注材料开发。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into any stage of bioprinting, focusing solely on biomaterial synthesis and characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发用于3D生物打印的海洋基生物墨水。
summary_zh.method: 通过物理和化学交联制备海藻酸钠/鱼明胶甲基丙烯酰互穿网络水凝胶。
summary_zh.result: 水凝胶具有高机械强度、低溶胀和降解速率，并成功应用于3D打印。
summary_zh.validation: 通过测量物理性能和细胞行为进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a marine-derived bioink for 3D bioprinting with improved properties.
summary_en.method: An interpenetrating polymer network hydrogel of alginate and fish gelatin methacryloyl was synthesized and characterized.
summary_en.result: The hydrogel exhibited enhanced mechanical strength, reduced swelling and degradation, and supported high cell viability in 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.validation: Physical property tests and in vitro cell assays were conducted.
